checkpoint: The detector checkpoint selected across all six training variants using only the separate detection-validation game.
thresholds: Let t be its detection-validation confidence threshold. Set video detection and final-output cutoffs to t. Test new-object admission at t, min(0.95,t+0.1), min(0.95,t+0.2). All other native association settings remain defaults.
reason: Box adaptation changes score calibration. Fixed pretrained admission/output cutoffs must not silently discard newly learned detections.
development: All nine clips in sam3-hybrid-protocol-20261024.json; no reference labels enter inference.
selection: Freeze the calibration maximizing correct-10*wrong, then observation coverage, then fewer uncertain joins before reused tracking regression. Report if this family fails to beat the pretrained or existing best pipeline.
regression: Four30-second clips plus the continuous five-minute Pittsburgh interval, evaluated once with the selected calibration.
runtime: Use the verified bounded decoded-frame cache and history-preserving CPU mask-memory offload. No per-player corrections or occlusion interpolation.
